lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 9 distinct, high-contrast white vertical lines are visible on the lateral torso. Spacing is semi-regular with a slight increase in gap width between the 4th and 5th lines relative to the anterior-most segments.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A singular Y-shaped bifurcation is observed at the dorsal terminus of the 7th vertical line from the anterior shoulder. No other merging lines are clearly visible.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The 1st (anterior-most) and 9th (posterior-most) lines are abbreviated, terminating approximately 40% down the torso mass. Line 4 shows a minor 5-pixel gap in continuity near the mid-lateral line.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 5 distinct white spots is located on the posterior flank, superior to the hind leg joint. Spot density is localized to the lower haunch area with an average inter-spot distance of approx. 15-20 pixels.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two circular spots on the lower haunch align horizontally to form a semi-connected geometric vector parallel to the ventral fringe.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The horns exhibit a lyrate trajectory, emerging at a ~75-degree angle from the frontal bone, spiraling laterally before curving medially at the apical 30% of the structure.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between terminal tips is approximately 1.75 times the width of a single horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping accounts for approximately 12% of the total visible horn length along the outer curvature.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly defined white chevron between the orbits; two distinct white spots on the cheek; high-contrast white distal limb markings (socks) transition to dark bands at the carpal and tarsal joints.
